title: An app window drawn by a canvas
blurb: An installable app whose title bar is an element of the canvas that covers the window. A simulated window on the page drags by the drawn title bar, and the installed app tests whether a real drag region follows the picture or the layout box.
question: Can the title bar of an installed app be an element drawn by a canvas, and does a drag region follow the place where the element is drawn?
result: The bar, its tabs and its text field work in a simulated window, and the computed app-region is found at the drawn position. A real installed window has not been measured.
